1.text: Zaburi ya Dawidi.Uwiteka burana n'abamburanya,Rwana n'abandwanya.

3.text: Kandi ushingure icumu mu ntagara wimire abangenza,Ubwire umutima wanjye uti “Ni jye gakiza kawe.”

4.text: Abashaka ubugingo bwanjye bamware bagire igisuzuguriroAbajya inama yo kungirira nabi basubizwe inyuma,Baterwe ipfunwe.

5.text: Babe nk'umurama utumurwa n'umuyagaKandi marayika w'Uwiteka abirukane.

6.text: Inzira yabo ibe umwijima n'ubunyereri,Kandi marayika w'Uwiteka abagenze.

7.text: Kuko bantegeye ikigoyi ku bushya badafite impamvu,Kandi badafite impamvu bateze ubugingo bwanjye ubushya.

8.text: Kurimbuka kumutungure,Ikigoyi yateze abe ari we gifata ubwe,Akigwemo arimbuke.

9.text: Ni bwo umutima wanjye uzishimira Uwiteka,Uzishimira agakiza ke.

10.text: Amagufwa yanjye yose azavuga ati“Uwiteka ni nde uhwanye nawe?Kuko ukiza umunyamubabaro umurusha amaboko,Ukiza umunyamubabaro n'umukene ubanyaga.”

11.text: Abagabo b'ibinyoma barahaguruka,Bakandega ibyo ntazi bakabimbaza.

13.text: Ariko jyeweho iyo barwaraga nambaraga ibigunira,Nkababarisha ubugingo bwanjye kwiyiriza ubusa,Ngasenga ncuritse umutwe mu gituza.

14.text: Nkamera nk'aho ari incuti yanjye,cyangwa mwene data urwaye,Nkiyunamira nkambara ibyo kwirabura nk'uborogera nyina.

15.text: Ariko ncumbagiye barishima baraterana,Abatagira umumaro banteraniraho sinabimenya,Baranshishimura ntibarorera.

16.text: Bampekenyera amenyo nk'uko abakobanyi bakora,Bakobana ibiteye isoni aho abantu basangira.

17.text: Mwami, uzageza he kundebēra gusa?Kiza ubugingo bwanjye kurimbura kwabo,Icyo mfite rukumbi gikize intare.

18.text: Nzagushimira mu iteraniro ryinshi,Nzaguhimbariza mu bantu benshi.

19.text: Abanyangira impamvu z'ibinyoma be kunyishima hejuru,Abanyangira ubusa be kunyiciranira amaso.

20.text: Kuko batavuga iby'amahoro,Ahubwo bajya inama yo gushaka ibyo babeshyera abatuza bo mu gihugu.

21.text: Banyasamiye cyane,Baravuga bati “Ahaa, ahaa, amaso yacu arabibonye.”

23.text: Ivurugute ukangukire kuncira urubanza,Urubanza rw'ibyanjye Mana yanjye, Mwami wanjye.

24.text: Uwiteka Mana yanjye,Uncire urubanza rukwiriye gukiranuka kwawe,Be kunyishima hejuru.

25.text: Be kwibwira bati “Ahaa, ni cyo twashakaga.”Be kuvuga bati “Tumumire bunguri.”

26.text: Abishimira ibyago byanjye bakorwe n'isoni bamwarane,Abanyirata hejuru bambikwe isoni n'igisuzuguriro.

27.text: Abakunda ko ntsinda nk'uko bikwiriye nibavuze impundu bishime,Iteka bavuge bati “Uwiteka ahimbazwe”,Wishimire amahoro y'umugaragu we.

28.text: Kandi ururimi rwanjye ruzavuga gukiranuka kwawe,Ruzavuga ishimwe ryawe umunsi wire.
